armed_S:
Create a single 4-column by 3-row sprite atlas on a square white canvas: exactly 12 equal rectangular cells, one full-body Aleksei pose centered inside every used cell, consistent body scale, no touching neighboring cells, no labels, text, borders, grid lines, cast shadows or extra people. Reference image 1 controls Aleksei's identity and painterly style; reference image 2 controls his in-game body size, clothing silhouette, color and foot placement only. Keep his gray fur ear-flap hat without badge, round glasses, dark charcoal-blue quilted winter coat, brown backpack and rolled bedroll, muted olive-gray trousers and dark winter boots. Realistic adult proportions around 7 to 7.5 heads tall, natural head and hand size, clear long legs. Use the established rough thick-oil finish: broad opaque brushstrokes, large flat color planes, broken dark outlines, coarse visible paint texture, cold muted winter colors, no photorealistic sheen, no soft 3D-render look, no anime or pixel art. Cell order: top row cells 0-3 = idle then three distinct walking phases; middle row cells 4-7 = four more distinct continuous walking phases; bottom row cell 8 = crouch/attack setup, cell 9 = special pose A, cell 10 = special pose B, cell 11 = spare duplicate of the idle pose. All poses keep the same camera scale and flat white background.
Direction: All characters face south toward the viewer, front view. Keep both boots visible; hands and weapon are in front of the chest.
Action set: Show a weathered Soviet compact service rifle held firmly with both hands in every pose: stock at the shoulder, support hand under the fore-end, barrel safely directed forward in the character's facing direction. Exactly one rifle; no rifle on the back, no second weapon. Bottom-row cells depict a low crouch ready pose and two crouch-walk phases with the rifle.
Anatomy rule: exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, one head; no duplicated limbs, no fused fingers, no extra weapon.
